T0556.title: Chargeback
T0556.definition: A payment reversal initiated through a card issuer or payment network after a dispute.
T0556.description: Chargeback is a payment reversal mechanism after a dispute. It protects consumers but can also be abused for “use first, dispute later” behavior. Risk controls should combine transaction evidence, delivery proof, account history, device behavior, and merchant risk to distinguish genuine disputes, friendly fraud, and organized abuse.
T0556.usageExample: Assess Chargeback related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
